Name: Leah with Pink Hair
Author: FarmerBriar
AuthorLabel: FarmerBriar based on mod by Poltergeister
Description:
I love Leah's character, but her design doesn't stand out. Not only are there (in my opinion) one too many redheads in the game, but Leah is a unique person with unique tastes. As an artist, she deserves better!

[b][size=4]SEASONAL LEAH WITH PINK HAIR[/size]
[/b]As a creative being, I imagine Leah would have a bit of artistic flair when it comes to her appearance. This mod gently adjusts her sprites and portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] to have pink hair and coordinating color outfits. Let Leah express herself her own way!

[b][size=4]CREDIT:[/size][/b]
This mod is a simple adjustment to Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] (See permissions for more info). The seasonal outfits mod is required in order to use this one.

[b][size=4]DIRECTIONS:[/size][/b]
1. To use this mod, you must have Slightly Cuter Seasonal Characters downloaded and set up properly with SMAPI and Content Patcher (see https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450). 
2. In the original mod folder, navigate to [ assets > characters > Leah ] and copy over the Leah files from the pink hair download file titled [characters]. 
3. Make sure you copy and replace the files, so only the pink hair files are in your mod folder.  
4. Do the same for the Leah Portraits, which will look something like this: [pink hair mod > portraits] *copy and replace to* [ assets > portraits > Leah ]. 
5. Run the game with SMAPI, and the new portraits/sprites will appear in-game.

[b][size=4]NOTE: [/size][/b]
Make sure you copy over the actual png. files instead of moving the folder.
